purpose: Literature-backed measurement/control library for phenomenon research; not a profitability ranking, causal finding, exact US factor replication, or strategy approval.
selection_policy: Foundational benchmark families plus independently published momentum, profitability, liquidity, lottery and accounting measurements. Definitions chosen before Korean return evaluation. No historical Gold values or alpha approvals imported.

sources.title: Kenneth French: Fama/French 5 Factors
sources.review_scope: Official factor construction, not a full paper replication

definitions.adaptation: Issue-level common-stock capitalization, not issuer sum across share classes and not SMB portfolio returns. Negative orientation denotes smaller size, not proven alpha.

definitions.name_ko: 최근 한 달 제외 12–2 가격 모멘텀
definitions.formula: adj_close_(t-1) / adj_close_(t-12) - 1, with every monthly price t-12..t-1 finite and positive
definitions.adaptation: Price-only KRX characteristic, not dividend-inclusive US Mom return. At formation month-end t for holding month t+1, latest return t is skipped. Missing calendar months invalidate the path; never use observation-row shifts across gaps.
Monthly price return characteristic rather than dividend-inclusive ST_Rev portfolio return. This is a control for recent performance; gross reversal need not survive transaction costs.

definitions.formula: sample_std(price_daily_return) over last 252 observed source rows; require >=200 finite returns; oriented_value=-raw

sources.title: AQR: Betting Against Correlation
sources.review_scope: Author discussion distinguishing total volatility, correlation and beta

definitions.adaptation: Local 252-observed-row total-volatility estimator and 200-observation rule, not BAB beta, idiosyncratic volatility, or minimum-variance optimization. Gaps/suspensions may lengthen calendar span. No annualization.

definitions.formula: mean_d(abs(price_daily_return_d)/trading_value_KRW_d) in month t, only positive trading value, require >=15 valid days
definitions.adaptation: Monthly KRW price-return ratio, not the paper's annual dollar-volume measure. Zero trading value is not zero illiquidity; units are inverse KRW, no implicit scaling. Higher orientation describes a possible illiquidity premium, not trading desirability.

definitions.formula: adj_close_t / max(adj_close_d, last 252 observed rows), require 252 positive price observations

sources.title: George and Hwang (2004): The 52-Week High and Momentum Investing
sources.review_scope: Publisher primary abstract and defining price/high characteristic

definitions.adaptation: 252 observed-row adjusted-price maximum is a local approximation to 52 calendar weeks. Not a reconstruction of the paper's complete portfolio sorts/holding rules; gaps can extend the calendar span.

definitions.name_ko: 복권형 극단 상승: 월간 최대 일수익
definitions.formula: max(price_daily_return_d) in month t, require >=15 finite daily returns; oriented_value=-raw

sources.title: Bali, Cakici and Whitelaw (2011): Maxing out
sources.review_scope: Author PDF; previous-month maximum daily return definition

definitions.adaptation: Price-only Korean MAX with a frozen 15-day measurement floor. Negative literature orientation is not a finding for Korea; not the multi-day averaged MAX variants.
Monthly PIT refresh differs from June annual US formation. Total equity is not automatically common book equity; issue cap cannot silently replace reconciled issuer equity.

blockers: Common-equity account and preferred/minority adjustments not authenticated
Paired issuer capitalization, filing vintage and accounting scope adapter absent

sources.title: Kenneth French: Portfolios Formed on Earnings/Price
sources.review_scope: Official earnings and price denominator definition

definitions.adaptation: Monthly availability-aware Korean variant, not the annually rebalanced US portfolios. Net income or EPS is not silently substituted for source-defined earnings. Negative-earnings treatment must be fixed with the account adapter.

blockers: Historical source-defined earnings mapping and ownership scope unverified

sources.title: Novy-Marx: The Other Side of Value (author manuscript, June 2012)
sources.review_scope: Sections 1 and 2.1, gross profits/assets and annual convention

definitions.adaptation: Monthly Korean PIT availability update instead of source June annual formation. Gross profit is not operating or net income. Financial-industry applicability must be explicitly scoped.

blockers: COGS and aligned annual numerator/denominator not authenticated

sources.title: Kenneth French: Size and Operating Profitability

definitions.adaptation: Korean component-based annual ratio refreshed on publication. Not operating-income/assets and not RMW returns. Missing cost components cannot be assumed zero without a frozen source reconciliation policy.

blockers: COGS/SGA/interest components and book-equity mapping unverified

definitions.formula: FY_assets_y / FY_assets_(y-1) - 1, comparable consecutive fiscal years; oriented_value=-raw
definitions.adaptation: Monthly publication refresh, not CMA returns. Repeated monthly carried-forward balance-sheet stocks do not constitute two annual observations. Do not sum asset stocks or blindly shift monthly rows.

blockers: Paired consecutive FY/same-scope/known-at ledger not bound

sources.title: Sloan (1996): Do Stock Prices Fully Reflect Information in Accruals and Cash Flows?
sources.review_scope: Original paper archived by academic institution; balance-sheet accrual definition

definitions.adaptation: Original balance-sheet approach recorded; no cash-flow proxy silently replaces it. Requires matched annual components and explicitly signed expense mapping, not quarterly cumulative differencing.

blockers: Matched current-asset/liability/tax/debt/depreciation accounts unavailable in authenticated monthly schema
Balance-sheet versus cash-flow accrual definition not interchangeable

definitions.formula: Source beta estimator = shrunk(correlation_i,m * sigma_i/sigma_m); BAB additionally beta-scales low/high portfolios and excess returns

sources.title: Frazzini and Pedersen (2014): Betting Against Beta
sources.review_scope: Author paper; beta estimation and beta-scaled long/short structure

definitions.adaptation: No executable Korean estimator selected. Do not label 252-day OLS or total volatility as canonical BAB. Leverage/borrow, market matching, risk-free and estimator details require a separate contract.

definitions.formula: Version-specific QMJ component standardization, quality score and size-balanced long/short portfolio; no substitute composite defined

sources.title: AQR: Quality Minus Junk Factors Monthly
sources.review_scope: Official dataset scope; not a complete executable component appendix

definitions.adaptation: Literature reference only until paper/data vintage and component rules are fully reconciled. Do not hand-select available ratios and call them QMJ. Ranks/composites belong to a separately frozen implementation.

blockers: Full version-pinned components and multi-year accounts not mapped

sources.title: Kenneth French: Market excess return in Fama/French Factors
sources.review_scope: Official Rm-Rf definition; Korean benchmark is separately specified

definitions.adaptation: KOSPI/KOSDAQ or explicitly matched combined universe and KRW RF, not US Mkt-RF. Realized t+1 market returns are contemporaneous explanatory controls, never t predictors. Price-only KOSPI is not TR; one common value repeated across stocks is not a stock-selection characteristic.

blockers: Universe-matched market TR and RF certification absent
